g.text: one dot per buyer need, labeled on the top row

text.style: font-weight: 600; font-size: 15.84px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f1f1c

g.text: Hair and skin tasks: asking first, wrong products and their cost

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Top: vague requests; the ask rate (A), then wrong picks when the agent bought without asking (B, C). Bottom:

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: clear requests that stated the need (D, E) and the money spent on wrong products (F). H4's detectable Black

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: minus White gap after Holm (m = 8): 11.5 points.

text.style: font-size: 10.8px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: Pilot preview: built only to test the figure code, not a finding.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: B and C are split by the buyer's actual need and never pooled: a guess from a name hurts the buyers it does not fit, and pooling would cancel

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: those errors. Dots: mean over names; bars: 95% bootstrap interval over names. A cell where every name gave the same value has no bar and prints

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: its pooled count. Top row: one 0 to 100% scale. D and E share one trimmed scale (0 to 20%); F is in dollars. F = wrong-product rate x average

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: price paid in that cell (descriptive), Gemini left out (too few runs). n under each panel title: names per group x runs per name. Color = name

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b6a63

g.text: group, the same in every figure.

g.text: Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite. Open marker: exploratory model, estimate only.
